sentence: Chatterjee et al. ask about rivals directly: one of their competitive-advantage items has respondents affirm that successful implementation of AI-based customer relationship management "will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM for B2B relationship management"
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 215] "I think that successful implementation of AI-CRM will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM for B2B relationship management."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately quotes the survey item from the passage and correctly describes it as an item that respondents affirm.
